description: Lake Malawi (Zambezi River Basin) - Small Water Bodies is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Agriculture", published or maintained by World Bank Group. Small water bodies inventory and water volume, covering the full Southern Province of Zambia, and includes of 1022 small reservoirs identified with optical satellite data from the Landsat5 satellite in the years 2010 and 2011. These locations are also available in excel file with LatLong coordinates for field inspection. Coverage: Zambia. It has 5 files in ZIP. The portal files it under Agriculture. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
